name: New Russia 2075
superGoal: Restore the Soviet sphere of influence and establish Russia as the dominant global superpower by 2075.

priorities.description: Maintain the largest and most technologically advanced military in the world. Prioritize nuclear deterrence, air force modernization, and naval power projection.
Achieve sustained GDP growth through resource exports, industrialization, and strategic trade partnerships. Target Top 3 GDP rank.
Re-establish sphere of influence over former Soviet states. Counter NATO expansion. Build alliances with China, India, and non-aligned nations.
Invest in military technology, AI, and cyber warfare capabilities. Close the technology gap with Western powers.
Maintain high stability and low unrest. Manage population growth through family incentives and healthcare investment.

constraints.rule: Avoid direct nuclear war with major powers (USA, China).
Do not provoke NATO Article 5 response unless strategically necessary and prepared.
Maintain positive relations with at least one major trading partner at all times.
Avoid excessive deficit spending that would destabilize the economy long-term.

victoryConditions.description: Achieve #1 GDP rank in the world
Achieve #1 Military rank in the world
Establish control or dominant influence over Eastern Europe (Ukraine, Belarus, Baltic states)
